Subject: Re: Stellaris RFP — contract questionnaire (Part C)

Marcus / Karthik,

I've reviewed the questionnaire and Marcus's draft. High-level guidance below (I included a redline doc attached):

1) IP / Model Improvements
- Do not accept broad assignment of customer IP to Redwood. Instead: grant a limited, revocable license to use customer-provided data for the sole purpose of providing the service and improving model performance in aggregate, with anonymization where requested.
- Add a carve-out: any customer-originated proprietary artifacts (models, annotated datasets) remain customer property unless a separate transfer is negotiated.

2) Liability cap
- Our standard position is cap = greater of (12 months fees) or $5M for enterprise deals.
- Accept carve-outs for willful misconduct, fraud, and any statutory liabilities. For data breach / exposure caused by Redwood's gross negligence, consider an elevated cap (e.g., 24 months fees) but avoid uncapped liability.

3) Indemnity
- Agree to defend & indemnify for third-party IP infringement claims to the extent caused by our service.
- Push back on broad indemnities that include customer data misuse unless Redwood materially caused the misuse.

4) Order form / SOW process
- We can accept your order form but require countersignature by an authorized Redwood signatory and a PO number for invoicing. If Stellaris requires standard form terms without redlines, that will require executive approval.

Next steps:
- I attached a redline (Redline_IP_Liability_Suggested.docx) with tracked language and alternate text we can offer.
- If Stellaris insists on assignment language, we should escalate to execs and propose a limited license + revenue share conversation.

I'll be available for a quick call with Stellaris legal if you'd like me to present the redlines.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0228

Emily — attaching our draft responses and a suggested redline for your legal team to review. Highlights up front so you don't have to dig through the doc: 

- IP: Redwood will not accept assignment of customer IP. We propose a limited license to use customer data for service delivery and aggregated model improvement, with an option for customers to opt-out of improvements that use raw training data.
- Liability cap: Our standard cap is the greater of (12 months fees) or $5M. We accept carve-outs for willful misconduct and fraud. For gross negligence leading to data exposure we can discuss a higher cap tied to 24 months fees, but cannot accept uncapped liability.
- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party IP claims stemming from our service. We will not accept broad indemnities for customer misuses of their own data.
- Order form: We can sign Stellaris's order form subject to countersignature by Redwood and a PO for invoicing; any material changes will require exec approval.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached redline (Redline_IP_Liability_Suggested.docx) and our line-by-line answers in Redwood_Responses_v0.1.docx.
2) If acceptable, confirm whether Stellaris wants the order form returned marked for signature or if you'd prefer a follow-up legal call.

Attachments: Redwood_Responses_v0.1.docx, Redline_IP_Liability_Suggested.docx
